title: Fit the original MODGEE model — fit_modgee
code: # Run or resume a bootstrap task in the current working directory. result_bootstrap <- fit_modgee(   M = example_M, groups = example_groups,   reference_group = "primary + old secondary", bootstrap = 10 ) result_bootstrap$bootstrap$status result_bootstrap$bootstrap$curve  # Fit without groups using automatic starting values. set.seed(123) result <- fit_modgee(M = example_M) result$summary  # Fit groups using the default reference group. set.seed(123) result_grouped <- fit_modgee(   M = example_M,   groups = example_groups ) result_grouped$groups$reference_group result_grouped$group_results$summary  # Select the reference group explicitly. set.seed(123) result_reference <- fit_modgee(   M = example_M,   groups = example_groups,   reference_group = "primary + old secondary" )  # Compare fixed-k and free-k models for grouped data. set.seed(123) result_grouped_k <- fit_modgee(   M = example_M,   groups = example_groups,   reference_group = "primary + old secondary",   do_k = TRUE ) result_grouped_k$do_k  # The k comparison is also available without groups. set.seed(123) result_k <- fit_modgee(M = example_M, do_k = TRUE) result_k$do_k  # Supply named group labels instead of a two-column data frame. group_labels <- setNames(example_groups[[2]], example_groups[[1]]) set.seed(123) result_labels <- fit_modgee(M = example_M, groups = group_labels)
